name: homie
description: A studio in a box on your own Cloudflare: set up a studio (one repository for games, music, videos and posts), make or remix multiplayer web games or make an existing single-player game multiplayer, make songs and game scores with ElevenLabs Music on your own account, make gameplay trailers and music videos (captured from your game, or generated with fal on your own account, under a budget with receipts), run the studio's site and public rooms on its own Cloudflare account (free plan, no payment method), and list it in the homie.rocks directory. Beta.
